method.execution: sequential engines → profiles → rounds → rotated editions; one browser process per engine, fresh context per run
method.timing: Fonts and gallery images decoded plus 3 RAF callbacks; 30 baseline intervals; 12 first opens (handler, 2 callbacks, decode + 2 more callbacks); 180 warm browse intervals changing card every 15; 180 sinusoidal scroll intervals over >80px overflow; wrap, full-editor structure, state API and name persistence checks. PNG export excluded.
method.accounting: Passive browser events while timed; the restricted server also observes actual favicon responses with a bounded Referer-keyed ledger. Body reads, hashes, size queries and Node audit-endpoint GETs happen only after timing. Resource-Timing-only favicon entries require one actual completed server response matching URL, unique page Referer and request interval within 25ms epoch-clock tolerance. The original browser observation, raw audit response and reconciliation proof are retained; browser transfer stays intact, unknown request/header bytes stay null. Audit GET traffic is post-workload instrumentation, not page traffic, and is recorded separately. Cold scope includes HTML and requests begun by galleryReady; total scope includes requests begun by workload end. Encoded body representation sizes exclude headers and may include cache-served representations when engine cache provenance is unavailable. Browser response transfer and request/header counts are separate and can be null. No wire-packet traffic or repeat-load cache experiment.
method.limitations: Headless DPR 1; unthrottled localhost. Layout profiles are not devices. Windows Playwright WebKit is not Mac Safari or a phone. RAF intervals are not real FPS; first-open timing is not INP. Four replicates describe this batch, not confidence intervals. R2 is not directly comparable to R1: content, decode workload and desktop viewport changed.
